scope_note: Phase-0 tests C3 dense-width sweep only; C5/C6/C7 separately gated; C8 event-coded closed negative. bpw figures are vote-accumulator term scope unless explicitly labeled inclusive persistent.
sub2_scope_caveat: bpw_reduction_at_structural_floor is vote-accumulator term only (16->7 bits); does NOT achieve sub-2 inclusive persistent — int8 q (~8b) and FP32 scale remain; at W7 structural floor persistent state is ~15 bits/weight. Narrows the int16 vote-acc dominator only; q term + scale must be addressed for sub-2.

reachable_range_structural_fact.w6_class: sub_floor_boundary_tested (clip 31 < peak 33; passes current overshoot battery)
reachable_range_structural_fact.w5_class: sub_floor_boundary_tested; breaks O3 on all 4 overshoot scenarios

reducibility_floor.structural_law: floor = T-1 + max_vote_abs; any width with clip_abs < floor can break O3 residual parity; if max_vote_abs rises in vivo the floor rises (less reducible)

classifier_labels.C3_RUN_HEALTH_FAIL: incomplete screen or missing mandatory width
classifier_labels.C3_INT16_STORAGE_OVERWIDE: W8 source-clip shrink only; not narrow-dynamics reducible
classifier_labels.C3_DENSE_WIDTH_REDUCIBLE: all sub-floor widths parity-safe on overshoot and bpw reduction target met
classifier_labels.C3_DENSE_WIDTH_REDUCIBLE_TO_FLOOR: reducible to structural clip floor W7 (~56% bpw off int16 vote-acc term only, not inclusive persistent budget); W5 breaks O3 on overshoot
classifier_labels.C3_NARROW_WIDTH_BREAKS_DECISION_PARITY: sub-floor width drifts on boundary overshoot scenarios (O1-O4)
classifier_labels.C3_DENSE_WIDTH_INTRINSIC_UNDER_CONTRACT: complete C3 grid; non-trivial variants break or miss byte target
classifier_labels.C3_CLIP_EXCEEDS_REACHABLE_RANGE: vote distribution never stresses sub-floor clip under documented bounds

fail_closed_rules: missing O5 never selects full-contract pass
